The journey of
Mommy Hummingbird

My two little eggs are waiting for me! Fly through the gardens of Cuba, drink nectar, escape the dangers and reach the nest so my chicks can hatch.

FlyMove your finger up and down. In front of a flower, tap Tongue to drink nectar.
ButtonsTurbo flies super fast. Wind Blast blows, Back flies backward and Hide keeps me hidden.
Watch out!A mantis, a chipojo lizard, a kestrel and a cat will try to catch me.
Screen:

The chicks hatched!
★★★

Garden Hero!

I'm teeny tinyThe smallest bird in the world: 2 inches long and lighter than a penny.
Super fast wings80 flaps every second. I can fly backward and hover in the air!
Only in CubaMy nest is the size of a thimble and my eggs are like coffee beans.

Plant flowers and protect forests: that's how you help the bee hummingbird!
